content:
maria: OK team, planning a short-cutover tonight 01:30 UTC for engine-kernel@4.12.2 and quant-bundle@v2.5-q8. Goal: low-risk patch (tiling fix) — canary 1% -> 20% -> 100%. Need quick ack on pins, prewarm, rollback triggers.

aj: Ack. pin TTL?

maria: pin TTL=1.5h on night-bucket. aj please run pre-bake at T-15m and verify signatures.

deploybot: DeployBot: scheduled rollout R-7900023 by @maria. Stages: 1,20,100. Pins: engine-kernel@4.12.2 pinned night-bucket ttl=90m.

luka: Staging note: small p99 blip (+12%) on matmul-heavy traces when cold. KV warm reduces the tail. No OOMs. I'll run a warm-prefill script before 20% stage.

sam: I'll add route-level fallback to q7 for long-context routes if A/B eval EM drops >1.5%.

nikhil: Rollback rules: auto-hold if p99 >+10% for 3 consecutive 5m OR errors +0.4% abs OR 2 hosts OOM in 10m. Auto-rollback target: engine-kernel@4.12.1 + quant-bundle@v2.5-q7.

aj: running bake & sigcheck now: `./scripts/bake.sh engine-kernel@4.12.2 && ./scripts/verify.sh engine-kernel@4.12.2`

deploybot: DeployBot: canary shifted to engine-kernel@4.12.2 for 1% (R-7900023). Telemetry guard enabled.

luka: canary smoke: p99 +4% after quick KV fill; errors steady. flipping to 20% in 10m unless anything trips.

maria: good. remember to update /docs/releases/ids and unpin at TTL expiry or manual unpin at 04:00 UTC. If anything odd, call rollback and capture logs.

sam: A/B eval started for key prompt set. Will post EM delta in 6m.

aj: all bakes OK. sig verified.

deploybot: DeployBot: advanced to 20% (R-7900023). Prewarm script ran on warmed hosts.

nikhil: metric snapshot at 20%: p99 +2.5%, errors +0.01%, no OOMs. Marking green.

luka: one host had a transient CUDA driver reset during synthetic stress; infra restarted container and recovered. Logging it.

maria: proceed to 100% if next 15m stays green. postmortem note: capture the driver-reset trace.

sam: eval EM delta -0.3% -> within fallback. Holding off fallback.

deploybot: DeployBot: rollout R-7900023 completed to 100% engine-kernel@4.12.2 / quant-bundle@v2.5-q8. Manual unpin scheduled at 04:00 UTC.

maria: thanks all. I'll run a 2h watch and then handoff. Keep incidents here if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
